mentions.name: QCReady
mentions.description: A free, no-sign-up web tool that measures a domain's Post-Quantum Cryptography readiness. It uses Certificate Transparency to discover all TLS endpoints in a domain, checks PQC usage among all the domain's TLS servers, and reports how far the domain is from PQC readiness (the percentage of TLS servers serving PQ cryptography).
mentions.problem: Organizations lack visibility into whether the TLS servers across their domains support post-quantum cryptography
mentions.audience: Domain owners and operators who want to assess their servers' Post-Quantum Cryptography readiness
mentions.source_excerpt:
Last week I launched https://qcready.com which measures your Post-Quantum Cryptography readiness.

- no sign up, free

- checks PQC usage among all the servers in a domain

- uses Certificate Transparency to find all your TLS endpoints

- tells you how far you are from PQC readiness
